Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGTE$BLK_LEVEL_ERROR_TRAP */
/* Trap errors returning from the server and report in a user friendly manner */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (40506, 40508, 40509, 40510) ) THEN

 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* Check and report the generic constraint violations */
 IF ( CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(server_err, server_msg) ) THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* Check and report the constraint violations specific to this block */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(server_msg);

 /* FK - Parent key not found */
 IF (server_err = 2291) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'SA_ORG_CER_SD_FK') THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(Des$FORM_ERRORS.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'STATS_PORT_CD,STATS_ISN' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SA_ORG_CER_MCI_CTRY_FK') THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(Des$FORM_ERRORS.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'FRGN_IMPR_CTRY' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SA_ORG_CER_MCI_APP_TY_FK') THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(Des$FORM_ERRORS.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'APPL_TYPE' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SA_ORG_CER_DCLTN_FK') THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(Des$FORM_ERRORS.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'DCLTN_PORT_CD,DCLTN_ISN' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSE
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* FK - Child record found */
 IF (server_err = 2292) THEN
 IF (err_code = 40509) THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40735 ) THEN


 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(server_err)||': '||server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(err_code)||': '||ERROR_TEXT, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.RAISE_FAILURE;

 END;
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-HELP

/* CGHP$CALL_HELP_FORM */
/* Call the help system after setting globals with current block and item */
BEGIN
 :GLOBAL.CG$HP_HFILE := '';
 IF (:GLOBAL.CG$HP_HFILE IS NULL) THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(Des$FORM_ERRORS.MSGGETTEXT(23, 'Help file is missing or incorrect'), 'W', 'OFG', 23);
 ELSE
 :GLOBAL.CG$HP_HFILE := :GLOBAL.CG$HP_HPATH || '';
 BEGIN
 CGHP$CALL_MS_HELP(
 0 /* IN : Help Context Id */
 ,:GLOBAL.CG$HP_HFILE); /* IN : Help Resource File */
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 CGTE$OTHER_EXCEPTIONS;
 END;
 END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGTE$BLK_LEVEL_ERROR_TRAP */
/* Trap errors returning from the server and report in a user friendly manner */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (40506, 40508, 40509, 40510) ) THEN

 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* Check and report the generic constraint violations */
 IF ( CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(server_err, server_msg) ) THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* Check and report the constraint violations specific to this block */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(server_msg);

 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (41105, 41106) ) THEN
 IF (err_code = 41105) THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(Des$FORM_ERRORS.MSGGETTEXT(35, 'Query of <p1> must be in context of <p2>', 'Sa Org Cert Dtls','Sa Org Cert' ), 'E', 'OFG', 35);
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.RAISE_FAILURE;
 ELSIF (err_code = 41106) THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(Des$FORM_ERRORS.MSGGETTEXT(36, 'Insert of <p1> must be in context of <p2>', 'Sa Org Cert Dtls','Sa Org Cert' ), 'E', 'OFG', 36);
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40735 ) THEN


 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(server_err)||': '||server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(err_code)||': '||ERROR_TEXT, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.RAISE_FAILURE;

 END;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: ADJUST_WIDTH
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Adjust_Width IS
 Shift number;
 ret number;
 ENTER_POS number;
 EXECUTE_POS number;
 OK_POS number;
 CANCEL_POS number;

BEGIN
 if :PARAMETER.WINDOW_WIDTH < 4 then
 ret := str.DispAlert('عرض القائمة أقل من الحد المسموح به','INFORMATION');
 elsif :PARAMETER.WINDOW_WIDTH > 8.2 then
 ret := str.DispAlert('عرض القائمة أكبر من الحد المسموح به','INFORMATION');
 else
 Shift := 1.75 - ((:PARAMETER.WINDOW_WIDTH - 4)/2);
 ENTER_POS := Get_Item_Property('PB_ENTER', X_POS);
 EXECUTE_POS := Get_Item_Property('PB_EXECUTE', X_POS);
 CANCEL_POS:= Get_Item_Property('PB_CANCEL', X_POS);
 OK_POS := Get_Item_Property('PB_OK', X_POS);

 Set_Item_Property('PB_ENTER', X_POS, ENTER_POS-Shift);
 Set_Item_Property('PB_EXECUTE', X_POS, EXECUTE_POS-Shift);
 Set_Item_Property('PB_CANCEL', X_POS, CANCEL_POS-Shift);
 Set_Item_Property('PB_OK', X_POS, OK_POS-Shift);

 Set_Window_Property('CGSO$WINDOW_1', WIDTH, :PARAMETER.WINDOW_WIDTH);
 Set_Canvas_Property('CG$PAGE_1', WIDTH, :PARAMETER.WINDOW_WIDTH);
 end if;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: ADJUST_HEIGHT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Adjust_Height IS
 V_HEIGHT number;
 SHIFT number;
 RET NUMBER;

BEGIN

 V_HEIGHT := Get_Window_Property('CGSO$WINDOW_1', HEIGHT);
 SHIFT := (12 - :PARAMETER.ROW_COUNT) * 0.25;

 Set_Canvas_Property('CG$PAGE_1', HEIGHT, V_HEIGHT);

 ELSE

ProgramUnit.Name: CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO */
FUNCTION CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(
 P_SERVER_ERR IN NUMBER /* Server error message */
 ,P_SERVER_MSG IN VARCHAR2) /* Server error number */
RETURN BOOLEAN IS
/* Check and report Primary/Unique Key, Check Constraint and User */
/* Defined Constraint violations */
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61); /* Violated constraint */
BEGIN
 /* Check if the error code is one we are interested in */
 IF ( NOT (P_SERVER_ERR IN (1, 2290) OR
 (P_SERVER_ERR >= 20000 AND P_SERVER_ERR <= 20999) ) )
 THEN
 RETURN( FALSE );
 END IF;

 /* Deal with user defined errors */
 IF (P_SERVER_ERR >= 20000 AND P_SERVER_ERR <= 20999) THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(''||CGTE$STRIP_FIRST_ERROR(P_SERVER_MSG), 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 RETURN( TRUE );
 END IF;

 /* Deal with Primary/Unique Key and Check Constraint violations */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(P_SERVER_MSG);
 IF (P_SERVER_ERR = 1) THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(P_SERVER_MSG, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (P_SERVER_ERR = 2290) THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(P_SERVER_MSG, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 RETURN( TRUE );
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGBS$TOGGLE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGBS$TOGGLE */
PROCEDURE CGBS$TOGGLE(
 P_QUERY_MODE IN OUT VARCHAR2) IS /* Query Mode */
/* Toggle query mode between BSMON and BSMOFF, set all query mode items, */
/* display query mode message, set the relations and ensure that the */
/* canvas is coordinated. */
BEGIN
 /* Toggle the mode */
 IF (P_QUERY_MODE != 'A') THEN
 P_QUERY_MODE := 'A';
 ELSE
 P_QUERY_MODE := 'A';
 END IF;
 /* Set all the items */
 CGBS$SET_QUERY_MODE( P_QUERY_MODE );
 /* Display query mode messages */
 CGBS$MESSAGE_QUERY_MODE( P_QUERY_MODE );
 /* Set the relations */
 CGBS$.SET_RELATIONS( P_QUERY_MODE );
 /* If the query mode is AutoQuery, coordinate outstanding blocks */
 IF (P_QUERY_MODE = 'A') THEN
 CGBS$.COORD_VISIBLE_BLKS( :SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK );
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: COPY_SELECTED_VALUES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* Formatted on 2015/04/27 12:50 (Formatter Plus v4.8.8) */
PROCEDURE copy_selected_values
IS
 msg_lvl VARCHAR2 (5);
 x NUMBER (7);
 y NUMBER (7);
 v_init NUMBER;
BEGIN
 msg_lvl := :SYSTEM.message_level;
 :SYSTEM.message_level := '25';
 v_init := 0;
 GO_BLOCK ('SA_ORG_CERT');
 GO_ITEM ('CHK_CERT');
 LAST_RECORD;
 y := :SYSTEM.cursor_record;
 FIRST_RECORD;

 FOR i IN 1 .. y
 LOOP
 IF :chk_cert = 1 AND :sa_org_cert.cert_isn IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 IF :parameter.p_dcltn_port_cd IS NOT NULL
 AND :parameter.p_dcltn_isn IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 BEGIN
 UPDATE sa_org_cert
 SET dcltn_port_cd = :parameter.p_dcltn_port_cd,
 dcltn_isn = :parameter.p_dcltn_isn
 WHERE cert_isn = :sa_org_cert.cert_isn;

 FORMS_DDL ('commit');
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 NULL;
 END;
 ELSIF :parameter.p_stats_port_cd IS NOT NULL
 AND :parameter.p_stats_isn IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 BEGIN
 UPDATE sa_org_cert
 SET dcltn_port_cd = :parameter.p_stats_port_cd,
 dcltn_isn = :parameter.p_stats_isn
 WHERE cert_isn = :sa_org_cert.cert_isn;

 FORMS_DDL ('commit');
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 NULL;
 END;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 x := :SYSTEM.cursor_record;

 IF x < y
 THEN
 NEXT_RECORD;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;

 DO_KEY ('exit_form');
 DO_KEY ('exit_form');
 :SYSTEM.message_level := msg_lvl;
END;

 IF (:SYSTEM.BLOCK_STATUS = 'CHANGED' OR CGBS2$.IS_COMMIT_NEEDED( :SYSTEM.TRIGGER_BLOCK ) ) THEN
 CGBS2$.DO_COMMIT_DIALOGUE;
 END IF;
 clear_record;
END;

/* CGBS$DISABLE_NXTKEY */

 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(Des$FORM_ERRORS.MSGGETTEXT(30, 'Key not valid in this context'), 'E', 'OFG', 30);

Trigger.Name: KEY-MENU
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGBS$TOGGLE_QUERY_MODE */
/* This changes the mode of block synchronization so that if it is */
/* currently ON, then it is changed to OFF, and vice-versa. */
/* It also queries the dependent blocks as appropriate for the */
/* new mode. */
BEGIN
 CGBS$TOGGLE( :GLOBAL.CG$QUERY_MODE );
END;

 IF :SYSTEM.FORM_STATUS = 'CHANGED' THEN

 END IF;
END;
